values.note: $22.52 a night (a January 2027 Tuesday and a June 2027 Friday both quoted the same), plus a $5.79 reservation fee and tax. The sites have water and 30/50-amp electric. Campers do not pay the forest's $2 day-use fee. The Florida Forest Service gives discounts to campers 65 and over, active-duty military and veterans, and the 100% disabled at applicable state-forest campgrounds, once the documentation is on file with ReserveAmerica. Read 2026-10-20.
